mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 950K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer discretionary spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST exceeds 950K.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) drops below 6.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200K in a month, a tightening labor market drives inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 2% YoY signals strengthening supply chains, boosting S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as manufacturers' profitability increases.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding $430B indicates strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days, as retailers and consumer discretionary stocks benefit.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A 25bp increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) within a month signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as borrowing costs rise.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 1.2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth slows to less than 100K in a month and unemployment (UNRATE) rises above 7%, a weakening labor market leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as investors anticipate easing monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 55% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: GDP (GDPC1) growth above 3% YoY, combined with a CPI (CPIAUCSL) increase below 2% YoY, indicates a 'goldilocks' economy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as growth is sustained without inflation concerns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 3% YoY and CPIAUCSL growth < 2% YoY
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.025 over any 1.8-year rolling window.
